## A second instance, on the endpoint this card's text actually names — and it confirms the card's thesis by being avoidable

`domain:ui` seat 3, 2026-09-18T18:13Z. ⭐ This is a **`PATCH`**, the endpoint `AGENTS.md` mutation ③ scopes the behaviour to, and it is this seat's own act rather than a relayed reading.

Acting on a contract review's finding, this seat edited PR objectui#9895's body in place. The body already ended with an attribution footer in the **session-URL** form. Following this card's own conclusion — that the `+58` is the platform's unconditional append and what produces the *doubling* is **sending a body that already carries a footer** — the footer was stripped from the sent body.

Read back on the response at 2026-09-18T18:12:19Z:

| leg | reading |
|---|---|
| bytes sent | 8,915 |
| bytes stored | **8,973** |
| delta | **exactly +58**, the same signature this card measures |
| footers in the stored body | **1** |
| form of the survivor | the **bare** `_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_` |

⇒ **Three things this pins that the card could previously only argue.**

1. The `+58` fires on `PATCH` of a **pull-request body**, not only on issue comments — so the signature is the platform's across body-bearing endpoints.
2. ⭐ The doubling is **avoidable by construction**: strip the footer and exactly one survives. That is the card's thesis, measured on the act rather than inferred from `post-stamped.mjs`'s behaviour.
3. ⚠️ The cost that remains is ⛔ **not** a second footer — it is that the rich **session-URL** form is replaced by the bare one. On this PR that lost nothing, because the PR-description attribution block already carries the session URL on its own line two lines above; but a body **without** that block would lose its only provenance link to a `PATCH`. That distinction is not in the AGENTS.md text either.

⛔ Nothing here changes what this card asks for: `AGENTS.md` is a governed surface and the repair is still a maintainer-approved edit, ⛔ not a seat-side one. This comment only adds the reading.

## The residual this seat predicted 8 minutes ago, then caused, then measured — ⛔ so "just strip the footer" is not the fix

`domain:ui` seat 3, 2026-09-18T18:21Z. Comment `5734245463` above closed by naming a cost that survives the strip: 「a body **without** that block would lose its only provenance link to a `PATCH`」. ⭐ That was a prediction. It has now happened, to this seat, on the next body it touched.

PR objectui#9926, `PATCH` at 2026-09-18T18:20:57Z: footer stripped before sending, platform appended `+58`, **one** footer stored — the mechanism worked exactly as measured. ⛔ But that body's session link lived **only** in the footer, unlike objectui#9895's, which carries a separate attribution block. Read back: `session URL: false`. ⇒ the link was gone, and ⛔ nothing in the act reported a loss, because by byte-count and footer-count the write was clean.

Restored at 2026-09-18T18:21:19Z as its own block above the footer, where a later patch cannot take it; read back present.

### What this adds to the card

The `+58` doubling has a **workaround** (strip before sending) and the workaround has its **own** failure mode, which the AGENTS.md text does not mention either:

| body shape | strip-then-PATCH outcome |
|---|---|
| carries a separate attribution block with the session URL | ✅ one footer, ⛔ nothing lost |
| carries the session URL **only** inside the footer | ⚠️ one footer, and the **provenance is silently gone** |

⇒ a seat that learns only 「strip the footer and the append leaves one」 will destroy provenance on the second kind of body and see a clean read-back while doing it. ⭐ Both halves belong in whatever the maintainer-approved edit says, and the durable shape is the one this comment used as the repair: **put the session link in its own block**, ⛔ not in the footer, so no append or strip can reach it.

⛔ Still not repaired seat-side: `AGENTS.md` is a governed surface. This comment adds the second reading only.
